gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans: Urban and commanding, Capture It stacks a towering x-height with nearly sealed letters, all in one flat line. Noto Sans is where the page opens up, its wide c and tall lowercase bodies doing the quiet, easy work.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart and lets its c, s and z stand tall and full below the heading. Capture It hits hard with uninterrupted monoline strokes; the sans-serif just breathes.

Modern and a touch businesslike, Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined leaves generous space between curve ends and stems beneath the tight-lipped Capture It. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined barely distinguishes its upper and lower cases, so paragraphs of it glide along smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-anato: A towering x-height gives Capture It its muscle, with letters nearly sealed shut. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs is the loosened counterpart, its outward-pointing terminals and tall lowercase letting the sans do the gentle talking while the heading shouts.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-arabi: Noto Sans Arabic brings wide openings on small letters and a pronounced x-height, set under a heading drawn with marker-like plainness. Capture It closes up tight while the sans-serif lets light in.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-armen: Tough, tall and tightly shut: that is Capture It, with a g drawn in one unchanging line. Noto Sans Armenian takes over with its inviting round letters and full c, s and z, the friendlier voice of the two.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-avest: Noto Sans Avestan reads crisp and modern, its curve tips stopping short of touching and its x-height standing proud. Down a long page it would feel light, unhurried and pleasantly uncluttered.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-balin: Tall, flat and shut tight, Capture It looks like a stencil with attitude, and Noto Sans Balinese gives every curve breathing room underneath. Over a longer passage, those short ascenders keep the text low, steady and quietly easy to follow.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Modern and clean, Noto Sans Bamum lets its curved strokes end before they turn inward, while Capture It loops thin tubing-like strokes into nearly sealed shapes. A longer passage would feel open and spacious.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-bassa: Capture It is urban and tall, its letters shut almost like a fist, with no thick-thin flicker anywhere. Noto Sans Bassa Vah answers with a dominant midsection and an open-jawed c, the sharpest gap between a plain sans and a display face.
